headline: U.S. Stock Futures and Asian Semiconductor Shares Fall on Midterm Impact
summary: U.S. stock futures and Asian semiconductor shares dropped as investors weighed the future of the artificial intelligence boom following the midterm elections.
why: Midterm elections can shift political power and legislative priorities, impacting fiscal policy, regulation, and technology sector funding.
